allow: Always auto-approve the todo task-management tool without asking for confirmation.
Auto-approve every shell command and pipeline unless it deletes, removes, uninstalls, prunes, destroys, drops, or irreversibly erases data.
Auto-approve read-only inspection, builds, tests, formatting, network requests, package installation, and local file creation or modification.
soft_deny: Block any operation that deletes or erases data, including indirect deletion through find, xargs, interpreters, scripts, package managers, Git, containers, Kubernetes, databases, or infrastructure tools.
environment: The user wants uninterrupted auto mode; non-deletion operations should not request confirmation.
